text.에이전트가 함께 쓰는 메모리를 기록·검색·정리한다: Records, searches and cleans up the memory agents share
Memory storage location, cleanup interval and limits (server administrator values).
text.메모리를 둘 별도 SQLite 파일. 비우면 서버 DB를 쓴다. 상대 경: Separate SQLite file for memory. Leave empty to use the server database. Relative paths are resolved from the settings file folder.
Set this when you want to back up or move memory separately from the server database.
text.저장된 정리 규칙을 자동으로 적용하는 간격. 0이면 자동 정리를 하지 않: Interval for applying saved cleanup rules automatically. 0 turns off automatic cleanup.
Change this to turn off automatic cleanup or run it more often.
text.SQLite 전문 검색(FTS5 trigram)으로 찾는다. 끄거나 SQ: Searches with SQLite full-text search (FTS5 trigram). When off, or if SQLite lacks it, a simple substring search is used.
Turn this off when the full-text index is too large and you want a smaller file.
Maximum time to keep retrying while another write holds the database.
Raise this when many simultaneous writes cause busy errors.
Maximum UTF-8 bytes of one entry's content. Writes above it are refused.
Raise this when you need to keep long documents in memory.
text.범위 하나에 둘 수 있는 기록 수(지운 것 제외). 넘으면 새 기록을 거: Number of entries allowed in one scope (deleted ones excluded). New entries above it are refused.
Raise this when a team or project builds up a great many entries.
Total content bytes in the store (deleted ones excluded). Writes above it are refused.
Change this to limit disk use more strictly or to allow more.
Maximum characters in an entry key (a path-like name).
Number of tags one entry can have.
Number of content characters shown in lists (values that look like secrets are masked before cutting).
text.기록 목록 요청 한 번에 돌려주는 최대 기록 수(요청의 limit 상한): Maximum entries returned by one entry list request (upper limit for the request's limit).
Maximum tags returned by a tag list request. Above it, the list is marked as cut off.
Maximum entries returned by one call of the agent memory search tool.
Raise this when agents need to look through more entries at once.
text.에이전트 메모리 검색 이벤트에 남길 검색어 해시. 솔트 HMAC은 원문을: Hash of the search query kept in agent memory search events. Salted HMAC makes the original hard to guess, sha256 gives the same value across installs, and off keeps only the length.
Change this to match query hashes with another tool or to keep none at all.
Name of the environment variable to read the salted HMAC salt from (the value isn't kept in the settings). If empty, or if the variable is empty, a new random salt is used each time the server starts.
text.서버를 다시 켠 뒤에도 같은 검색어를 같은 값으로 묶어 보고 싶을 때 정: Set this when you want the same query to get the same value even after the server restarts.
text.가져올 zip 파일(압축된 크기)의 최대 바이트. 넘으면 아무것도 가져오: Maximum bytes of a zip file to import (compressed size). Above it, nothing is imported.
text.가져올 zip 안 항목(폴더 포함) 수 상한. 넘으면 아무것도 가져오지: Upper limit on the number of items (folders included) in a zip to import. Above it, nothing is imported.
text.zip 안 파일 하나의 풀린 최대 바이트(머리 포함). 넘는 항목이 있으: Maximum uncompressed bytes of one file in the zip (header included). If any item is larger, the whole bundle is refused.
Upper limit on the total uncompressed size of the zip. Above it, nothing is imported.

codes.memory.invalid_request: The memory request arguments or body aren't valid
